data.title: Nvidia Earnings Could Set The Tone For Bitcoin, MSTR: Here’s What Retail Traders Are Watching
data.description: Strategy (MSTR) shares plunged sharply overnight heading into Monday as the stock played catch-up to Bitcoin’s (BTC) weekend slump, while retail traders on Stocktwits looked to Nvidia’s (NVDA) earnings this week for the next cue.MSTR stock was down more than 7% overnight.
